GEOGRAPHY — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #1
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: GEOGRAPHY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Name the president
   C. Replace the compass rose
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

2. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.
   C. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.

3. Which statement about Water Cycle and Action of Rivers is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Water Cycle and Action of Rivers as rumours only.
   B. Explain Water Cycle and Action of Rivers with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Water Cycle and Action of Rivers.
   D. Say Water Cycle and Action of Rivers never happens in Kenya.

4. Which statement about Mass Wasting is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Mass Wasting.
   B. Say Mass Wasting never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Mass Wasting as rumours only.
   D. Explain Mass Wasting with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. Which statement about Statistical Methods is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Statistical Methods never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Statistical Methods.
   D. Treat Statistical Methods as rumours only.

6. Which statement about Weather is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Weather.
   B. Treat Weather as rumours only.
   C. Explain Weather with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Weather never happens in Kenya.

7. Which statement about Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in.
   C. Say Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in as rumours only.

8. Which statement about Elementary Surveying is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Elementary Surveying.
   B. Treat Elementary Surveying as rumours only.
   C. Say Elementary Surveying never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Elementary Surveying with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. Which statement about Climate is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Climate as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Climate.
   C. Say Climate never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Climate with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. Which statement about Soils is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Soils.
   B. Say Soils never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Soils as rumours only.
   D. Explain Soils with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

12. Which statement about Vegetation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Vegetation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Vegetation.
   C. Say Vegetation never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Vegetation as rumours only.

13. Which statement about Geographic Information Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Geographic Information Systems as rumours only.
   B. Say Geographic Information Systems never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Geographic Information Systems.
   D. Explain Geographic Information Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

14. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Mombasa
   B. Nakuru
   C. Nairobi
   D. Kisumu

15. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Hide all money underground
   D. Ignore prices in shops

16. Which statement about Weathering is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Weathering as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Weathering.
   C. Say Weathering never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Weathering with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Statistical Methods and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Geographic Information Systems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Weather and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Climate and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Vegetation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Weathering and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Mass Wasting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Soils and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain Water Cycle and Action of Rivers and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

26. In three clear sentences, explain Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
